text:
sam: Quick poll: if our models were coworkers, which one would consistently steal the office plant and water it with coffee?

lea: 100% the 'ambitious-gen' model. tries to optimize everything, even photosynthesis. :seedling:

omar: haha, 'ambitious-gen' would also draft a 12-step plan to monetize the plant.

tess: I'm voting for 'confident-small' 
as they'd be like: 'I watered it. it is thriving. you are welcome.' :sunglasses:

sam: we need names. options: ambitious-gen, confident-small, empathetic-chat, and bug-fix-qa. react with :one: :two: :three: :four:

infra-bot: Poll created 
React with :one: for ambitious-gen, :two: for confident-small, :three: for empathetic-chat, :four: for bug-fix-qa

lea: :one: because the plan is elaborate and unnecessary.

omar: :two: I love the smugness.

tess: :three: would definitely apologize to the plant and write it a tiny poem.

sam: note: 'bug-fix-qa' would sneakily add a tiny patch to the pot to 'improve drainage' and cause an incident report. :memo:

lea: We should make a Slacklight: "Model Pet Behavior" for onboarding. tiny gifs, archetypes, and required reactions.

omar: Also a bingo card: "Leaves wilting because model suggested canned coffee as fertilizer" as a square.

infra-bot: Reminder: channel pin updated with latest community polls -> /pins.

tess: lowkey MVP idea: assign an emoji to each model persona and auto-react when someone mentions a model name. 

sam: tagging @ops - this could be a harmless morale project. also, someone please stop putting actual coffee in the watering can.

lea: agreed. will add "no caffeinated watering" to the kitchen sticky note. :coffee:

omar: spoke to facilities: they blame the plant for being too charismatic. :laughing:
